bradb0wman: Dorian Wman, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 3 to fill a gap in R-F5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Dorian Wman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dorian Wman had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dorian Wman. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Dorian Wman spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F5 is closed now.
caydan__: Dietrich Caydan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Dietrich Caydan was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Dietrich Caydan was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Caydan wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Dietrich Caydan closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.

Dietrich Caydan caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either. A letter from home reached Dietrich Caydan before dusk. Dietrich Caydan read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dietrich Caydan pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Lantern Hill and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
dilloncoll2015: In Ashford Vale, Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was a railway porter. In R-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.

Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll tried to describe the smell of Ashford Vale and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
A second spoon disappeared. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
jozifanderson: Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
First Wave. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso pulled Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor out of a flooded shell hole at the Drowned Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant.

Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin Adams crossed it, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso fired. Quentin Adams was grazed. A shell burst over R-F11 and threw Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post.
thebaileeblanks: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla taught Jakub Lilsaint to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Asked what he will do after the war, Florian "Button" Thebaileebla said: 'Be a railway porter in Marrow Fen. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
A bullet found Florian "Button" Thebaileebla at S-F17, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
